concerns.text: Tasks T008 and T009 tag FR-002 and FR-007 but implement loading `mistralai/Mixtral-8x7B-v0.1` (~47B params). FR-002 explicitly requires a '1B parameter MoE student'. The task description contradicts the spec requirement it claims to cover, meaning the spec's FR-002 (1B MoE) has no valid task implementation.

Tasks T005.0, T014.5, and T014.6 tag SC-006 and FR-009 but rely on fetching data from `HuggingFaceH4/aime_2024_human_labels`. This dataset ID does not exist in the public HuggingFace Hub. Consequently, the tasks cannot satisfy SC-006 (validation against human-verified labels) or FR-009 (held-out evaluation), leaving these requirements unimplemented.

Tasks T042.5 and T043 tag FR-006 and SC-002/SC-004 but assume the existence of 'performance gain distributions' derived from multiple independent runs. The plan and tasks (T024, T034) only define a single run (500 steps) per architecture. There is no task to generate the multiple samples required for the statistical tests (t-test/Wilcoxon) mandated by FR-006, leaving the statistical validation requirement unmet.

Task T006.1 tags FR-009 (held-out set evaluation) but only implements the data split. There is no explicit task ensuring the training loop (T020/T030) strictly excludes the held-out set during training, creating a gap in coverage for the 'distinct validation target' constraint of FR-009.

Tasks T005.0 and T014.5 contain duplicate/conflicting descriptions for the same dataset fetch logic (one raises FileNotFoundError, one suggests fallback/local path). This indicates stale or inconsistent tagging/description for the non-existent dataset ID, requiring cleanup.
